tools.name: date_to_binary
tools.description: Convert a date (birthday, anniversary, due date) to its BinaryBirthday code: 12-bit year, 4-bit month, 5-bit day. Returns gift links with the code pre-filled.

tools.name: text_to_binary
tools.description: Convert text such as a name, initials or a short message to 8-bit binary (UTF-8). Text up to 16 characters also returns gift links.

tools.name: binary_to_text
tools.description: Decode binary (0s and 1s, spaced or not) into text, and also read it as a whole number.

tools.name: number_to_binary
tools.description: Convert a whole decimal number to binary.

tools.name: binary_to_number
tools.description: Convert binary to a whole decimal number.

tools.name: suggest_binary_gifts
tools.description: Suggest personalized binary-code gifts for programmers, engineers, couples or new parents. Give a date or a short text and get each product with a link that pre-fills the code. Use when the user asks for gift ideas for a techie, a geek, an anniversary or a baby.
